input.overview: Light Lockjaw and lock three balls there to start Bluto Multiball, then alternate left-ramp Jackpots with Lockjaw relights. Four Fight Bluto rounds, Sea Hag Multiball, and upper-playfield animal progress continue on their own routes.
input.simpleOverview: Hit both Jab targets to light Lockjaw, then lock three balls there for Bluto Multiball. During Multiball, shoot the left ramp for a Jackpot and return to Lockjaw to relight it; a lit Spinach Can on the ramp doubles the collect.
input.summary: Build Bluto Multiball by hitting both Jab targets and locking three balls at Lockjaw. Alternate the left ramp and Lockjaw for growing Jackpots, while using O-Y-L to qualify the separate Fight Bluto rounds and SEA-HAG to build the four Sea Hag items.

quickInfo.name: Bluto Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Light Lockjaw from both Jab targets, the skill wheel, or an Escalator award, then lock three balls at Lockjaw.

quickInfo.name: Sea Hag Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete SEA-HAG to light Collect Item at the left ramp. Collect all four items from the ramp or skill wheel to begin four-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Fight Bluto
quickInfo.summary: Complete O-Y-L to light the upper Fight Bluto sinkhole. The four rounds use flashing shots to stop a different environmental scheme.

quickInfo.name: Kneedeep
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the Escalator when available to reach the upper mini-playfield, search for Swea’ Pea, and reach the Animal section.

quickInfo.name: Sail Again
quickInfo.summary: The between-flipper lamp shows the ball saver. The factory default is off, so check the machine before relying on it.

steps.text: Hit both Jab targets to light Lockjaw. Lockjaw can also be lit by the skill wheel or a selected Escalator award.
Shoot Lockjaw three times while Lock is lit to load the balls and start Bluto Multiball.
During Bluto Multiball, shoot the left ramp for the Jackpot, then shoot Lockjaw to relight it. Repeat while at least two balls remain.
Collect a lit Spinach Can at the left ramp before a Jackpot when control allows; the Spinach doubles that ramp collect until the machine reaches its cap.
If two balls drain before the first Jackpot, shoot Lockjaw during the short restart timer instead of abandoning the Multiball route.
For the separate Fight Bluto route, complete O-Y-L in the top lanes and shoot the lit upper sinkhole. Follow the flashing targets for the current environmental round.

alternatives.title: Sea Hag items
alternatives.when: Use this when the SEA-HAG targets and left ramp are safer than repeated Lockjaw shots.

steps.text: Hit SEA and HAG to light Collect Item at the left ramp.
Collect the four displayed items from the lit left ramp or skill wheel to start Sea Hag Multiball at the Animal sinkhole.
During Sea Hag Multiball, follow the lit owner shots because the return shot can vary by ROM or game state.
Complete O-Y-L and shoot the lit Fight Bluto sinkhole for Earth Pavers, Never Green Logging, Blutonium Waste, or Spill Oil Co.
Complete each round by following its flashing targets and display objective.
Finishing all four qualifies Mutant Spinach Multiball; follow the display because scoring can vary by ROM or game state.

machineSetup: Check the between-flipper Sail Again lamp at the start of a ball. The factory default ball-saver setting is off.

playfieldReferences.label: Bluto lock and relight sinkhole
playfieldReferences.description: The center sinkhole below Bluto used for locks, Multiball kickout, Jackpot relights, and restarts.

playfieldReferences.label: Item and Jackpot ramp
playfieldReferences.description: The left ramp used to collect lit Items, Spinach Cans, and Bluto Multiball Jackpots.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper Fight Bluto start
playfieldReferences.description: The upper sinkhole beside Bluto that starts a lit Fight Bluto round.

cautions.issue: PX-3 behavior leaves several later features incomplete, and other ROM revisions can differ.
cautions.response: Follow the display for Sea Hag return-shot values, Stampede alternatives, Mutant Spinach scoring, and Rescue Olive details.

cautions.issue: Bluto Multiball ejects balls toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Use the active Multiball ball saver to settle the kickouts before shooting for the first left-ramp Jackpot.
